title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy object-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
description: The object-src directive permits plaintext HTTP plug-in and document objects, so an embedded PDF or legacy object can be replaced in transit before the browser renders it.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit object-src directive.
risk: An embedded document is rewritten on the wire into attacker-chosen content inside the trusted page; MEDIUM because the object cannot script the parent, but it can phish and mislead.
